e.text: A3 and A2 triple the benchmark; asking the Critic how to combine the brand drops with local seeding.

e.note: Reading results for A2, A3

critique.summary: Both taste-driven plans roughly triple the benchmark (12.3–12.5% vs 4.2%) at about a third of the cost per point, with co-branded drops (Vice 22.6%, Polaroid 23.1%) doing the heavy lifting. A3 edges ahead on mean, 10th percentile (11.3% vs 10.9%) and cost ($776 vs $812 per point), but it is concentrated in Indie rock and Drag Race (17.6%) and weak elsewhere (5.3–6.9%), while late street teams and the day-32 pop-up add little.

findings.finding: Best overall at 12.5% reach (P10 11.3%) for $776 per point; the Polaroid drop from day 0 earns 23.1% of adoption for $2000, and $300 partners earn 1.4–2.2% each, far more efficient than the street teams at 1.2–1.4% for $450.
Street teams on days 30–31 and the Madeline's pop-up on day 32 come too late for word of mouth to spread before launch, and districts outside Indie rock and K-pop stay at 5.3–6.9%.
Broadest coverage at 8.9–13.9% across all districts with 45.8% word of mouth; the Vice drop earns 22.6% for $2000, but each $3500 podcast earns only 9.7%, about 3.5x the cost per share of the drop.
Williamsburg social (social:3) earns only 1.4% of adoption for $960, so it is a weak use of the money.
Reaches 4.2% (P10 3.6%) at $2346 per point; broad social earns 24.6% of its adoption for $4680, and its street teams earn 0.0–0.5% each for $450.

changes.change: In A3, drop street:3 (day 30), street:1 (day 31) and the Madeline's pop-up on day 32 ($3400 total), and fund the Vice collab (collab:A5707876) from day 5 at $2000 alongside Polaroid.
changes.why: Drops return about 23% of adoption per $2000, while the late actions return about 1.2–2.2% each and run too late for word of mouth to compound.

changes.change: Use the remaining ~$1400 to add 3–4 more $300 partners in zones 3 and 1 (Williamsburg, fit 0.9 and 0.865) and zone 2 (Bed-Stuy), seeded before day 10.
changes.why: Partners are A3's most efficient line items at 1.4–2.2% per $300, and early seeding in the highest-fit zones lifts word of mouth.

changes.change: Drop social:2 or social:3 in A3 if it is needed to fund the Vice drop; if the budget allows, keep one podcast (Las Culturistas, day 10) rather than social.
changes.why: A2 shows Williamsburg social earned 1.4% for $960, and the Vice drop plus the podcast broaden reach in the weak Podcasts and Latin pop districts.

e.note: Both taste-driven plans roughly triple the benchmark (12.3–12.5% vs 4.2%) at about a third of the cost per point, with co-branded drops (Vice 22.6%, Polaroid 23.1%) doing the heavy lifting. A3 edges ahead on mean, 10th percentile (11.3% vs 10.9%) and cost ($776 vs $812 per point), but it is concentrated in Indie rock and Drag Race (17.6%) and weak elsewhere (5.3–6.9%), while late street teams and the day-32 pop-up add little.

e.text: Applying the Critic's notes: add Vice next to Polaroid, cut late street teams and pop-up.

e.note: Revising: From A3: cut day 30-31 street teams and Madeline's pop-up; add Vice drop from day 5 alongside Polaroid; add 3-4 early $300 partners in zones 1-3 before day 10. Variant 2: also cut social and keep Las Culturistas on day 10.

voices.name: Danny
voices.quote: I saw a poster for it at Mr. Throwback while I was digging through the jackets, and the Polaroid thing caught my eye. I'm more of a concert guy, but if it's got a good soundtrack I might head over the bridge.

voices.name: Maya
voices.quote: Honestly, I heard about it on Las Culturistas first and then saw the flyer at Good Room that same weekend, so it felt like the universe was telling me. Euphoria meets Lady Bird at Nitehawk? I'm already texting my group chat.
voices.change: Already bringing friends; a Phoebe Bridgers-style afterparty seals it.

voices.name: Jordan
voices.quote: There's a little card at Stonefruit by the register, and the bartender at House of Wax was talking about it too. A24 coming-of-age stuff always gets me, so yeah, I'll make the trip to Williamsburg.
voices.change: Free Polaroid prints at the screening would get my roommate there.

voices.name: Luis
voices.quote: First I'm hearing of it, to be honest. Brooklyn's a trek from here and indie movies aren't really my thing, but it sounds cool for the people who like that.
voices.change: A screening closer to Newark or a reggaeton-heavy soundtrack.

e.note: Writing the launch plan for B2

plan.headline: Polaroid drop plus Las Culturistas: about 4x the benchmark's reach of the natural audience
plan.summary: The bet is a day-1 co-branded Polaroid drop and 13 Brooklyn/LES taste-matched partners, amplified by a host-read Las Culturistas ad 24 days out so word of mouth has time to spread before preview week. Qloo taste data shows this audience over-indexes on Polaroid (affinity 0.95), Las Culturistas (0.90, pulled in by Lady Bird and A24) and every partner venue (0.91–0.93). The simulation, built on Qloo taste data and not a guarantee, projects 17.4% reach of the natural audience (range 15.7%–19.0%), about 4.1x the 4.2% benchmark at $575 per point of reach versus $2,346, with word of mouth driving about half of adoption.

weeks.label: Week 1 (days 35–29 before launch)
items: Day 34: launch the co-branded Polaroid drop; it runs through launch day.
Day 34: start targeted social ads in Williamsburg for 10 days.
Sign and stock all 13 partners with posters, register cards and Polaroid tie-in materials for the whole campaign.
Brief partner staff (bartenders, baristas) on the film and preview dates at Nitehawk.

weeks.label: Week 2 (days 28–22)
items: Day 24: Las Culturistas host-read ad with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang airs.
Day 24 onward: social ads end; check partner materials are visible the weekend after the podcast.
Refresh flyers at top-crediting venues: Good Room, Madeline's, Isola Brooklyn.

weeks.label: Weeks 3–4 (days 21–8)
items: Keep the Polaroid drop visible at partners to fuel group-chat word of mouth.
Restock cards at Stonefruit, Nostrand Coffee Roaster and Dun-Well Doughnuts.
Track word-of-mouth signals and partner pickup weekly.

weeks.label: Final week to preview week (days 7–0)
items: Last restock and reminder push across all 13 partners.
Run preview week at Nitehawk Cinema Williamsburg with Polaroid drop on site.
